summary: The PR proves the general pointwise slice-tube theorem but leaves a separate, duplicated free-action proof of the same construction in `GroupAction/Quotient.lean`, and it re-derives facts (surjective differential, explicit complement `EG`, orbit dimension) that the core construction already proves privately or weakens.
